verses.pali: “Ānāpānassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated it’s very fruitful and beneficial.

verses.pali: Kathaṁ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, ānāpānassati kathaṁ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā?
verses.english: And how is mindfulness of breathing developed and cultivated to be very fruitful and beneficial?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṁ ābhujitvā ujuṁ kāyaṁ paṇidhāya parimukhaṁ satiṁ upaṭṭhapetvā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant—gone to a wilderness, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty hut—sits down cross-legged, sets their body straight, and brings mindfulness to the present.
Just mindful, they breathe in. Mindful, they breathe out. …
They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe in observing letting go.’ They practice like this: ‘I’ll breathe out observing letting go.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassati evaṁ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā.
verses.english: Mindfulness of breathing, when developed and cultivated in this way, is very fruitful and beneficial.

verses.pali: Evaṁ bhāvitāya kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassatiyā evaṁ bahulīkatāya satta phalā sattānisaṁsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
verses.english: When mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated in this way you can expect seven fruits and benefits.
You attain enlightenment early on in this very life.

verses.pali: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṁ ārādheti.

verses.english: If not, you attain enlightenment at the time of death.

verses.pali: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṁ ārādheti, no ce maraṇakāle aññaṁ ārādheti.
Atha pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti …
verses.english: If not, with the ending of the five lower fetters you’re extinguished in between one life and the next …
you head upstream, going to the Akaniṭṭha realm …

verses.pali: evaṁ bhāvitāya kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassatiyā evaṁ bahulīkatāya ime satta phalā sattānisaṁsā pāṭikaṅkhā”ti.
verses.english: When mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated in this way you can expect these seven fruits and benefits.”
